regions.region: page 1 title, authors, abstract, and article metadata
regions.finding: Verified the source title 'Catalytic Asymmetric Synthesis of Chiral Allenylic Fluorides Enabled by Multiple Radical Sorting', DOI 10.1002/anie.202518286, and aggregate nickel-catalyzed three-component asymmetric radical-sorting claim. The abstract is a current-work summary, not an experiment-specific arrow.

regions.region: page 1 two-column introduction and prior allene/fluoride discussion
regions.finding: Classified established chiral allylic/propargylic fluorides and cited radical enyne difunctionalizations as prior/context chemistry. External cited work was not promoted to current-paper experiments.

regions.region: page 1 current-design paragraph at lower right
regions.finding: Linked ICH2F radical generation and multiple-radical-sorting design to the current generic Figure 1iii record; proposed pathways are not isolated preparations.

unresolved: The page-1 generic/context drawings do not define experiment-specific charges or yields.
The publisher advertises online Supporting Information, but workspace SI association remains unestablished.

regions.region: page 2 upper Figure 1i
regions.finding: Visually classified the allylic/propargylic-versus-allenylic fluoride comparison as prior/context material rather than a current experiment.

regions.region: page 2 upper-middle Figure 1ii
regions.finding: Visually classified the generic enyne radical difunctionalization pathway and its limited alkynyl/CN/aryl examples as cited prior-work context; no current-paper yield was assigned.

regions.region: page 2 Figure 1iii current-work panel
regions.finding: Classified the ICH2F/alkyl-halide/Ni/Zn radical-sorting graphic as a current general scheme with proposed radical and carbenoid branches. The >40-example/up-to-95%-ee statements remain aggregate, not row-specific outcomes.

regions.region: page 2 lower two-column design discussion and beginning of model-reaction paragraph
regions.finding: Linked the model 1/2/3 reaction setup to Table 1 on page 3. The page introduces the optimization but does not itself supply a completed row result.

unresolved: Figure 1 uses generic colored substituent nodes and does not provide unique experiment structures or charges.
No SI association was inferred from the publisher statement.

regions.region: page 3 upper Table 1 reaction drawing and ligand structures L1–L10
regions.finding: Visually identified model enyne 1, alpha-bromoester 2, ICH2F 3, product 4, NiBr2·(PPh3)2, Zn/DMAc, and all ten ligand labels. Candidate structures are not treated as verified.

regions.region: page 3 Table 1 entries 1–15 and footnotes a–c
regions.finding: Recorded every optimization row independently with shared quantities, row ligand/solvent/temperature/stoichiometry changes, GC yields, ee values, n.d./trace/dash markers, and analytical bases. The final entry-15 model condition is merged with Scheme 1 product 4 and the Scheme 3b ICH2F reference row.

regions.region: page 3 Table 1 grouped entry 16 and lower optimization prose
regions.finding: Split the grouped no-Ni/no-ligand/no-Zn entry into three distinct omission controls because the page-4 continuation explicitly says omission of any one component gives complete loss of reactivity. Preserved the entry-15 prose 87% value alongside the table/Scheme 1 83% values as a source conflict.

unresolved: Final-condition yield conflict: Table 1 gives 83% GC, Scheme 1 gives 83% isolated, and optimization prose gives 87% without a stated basis.
Table 1 omits atmosphere, workup, purification, isolated masses, and numerical detection limits.

regions.region: page 4 upper-left optimization continuation
regions.finding: Confirmed entry 15 as the optimal condition and entry 16 as three distinct essential-component omissions; retained the 87%-versus-83% yield discrepancy rather than correcting it.

regions.region: page 4 left-column Scheme 1 scope and scale-up discussion
regions.finding: Mapped products 4–35, functional-group classes, complex enyne derivatives, and the 3.0 mmol product-4 scale-up to the page-5 arrows. Repeated product 4 standard evidence is merged; the scale-up is separate.

regions.region: page 4 lower-left and upper-right Scheme 2 scope discussion
regions.finding: Mapped products 36–48 to the page-6 arrows, including two ee values and approximately 1:1 dr for 46, primary-radical products 47/48, and X-ray/recrystallized (S)-45.

regions.region: page 4 right-column Scheme 3a radical-trap and D2O discussion
regions.finding: Recorded four TEMPO trap/omission rows and the distinct 5-equiv D2O probe. Product 4 suppression, 49/50 yields, and non-detection of CHDF/CD2F products remain product-targeted; SI-only details were not imported.

regions.region: page 4 lower-right Scheme 3b alpha-halogen discussion
regions.finding: Merged the ICH2F reference result into the standard model record and recorded ICH2Cl, ICH2Br, and ICH3 controls separately with decomposition/complex-mixture or retained-starting-material outcomes.

unresolved: Scope prose supplies aggregate functional-group interpretation but not row-specific workups, masses, or atmosphere.
Mechanistic controls omit several yield bases, detection limits, and operational details; unassociated SI data were not used.
Product 46 does not assign its two ee values to named major/minor diastereomers.

regions.region: page 5 Scheme 1 reaction header/caption
regions.finding: Visually verified the shared alkyl bromide 0.1 mmol, enyne 1.5 equiv, ICH2F 2 equiv, Ni catalyst 10 mol%, L7 16 mol%, Zn 3 equiv, DMAc/toluene 3:17 at 0.05 M, −10 °C, 24 h conditions; yields are isolated and ee is by chiral HPLC.

regions.region: page 5 Scheme 1 products 4–28
regions.finding: Recorded every distinct product arrow and printed isolated yield/ee. Product 4 is merged with Table 1 entry 15; products 5–28 are separate scope records. No compact structure was forced into a verified SMILES.

regions.region: page 5 Scheme 1 complex enynes 29–35 and 3 mmol annotation
regions.finding: Recorded seven named bioactive-molecule derivative arrows and the separate 3 mmol product-4 experiment (73%, 91% ee). The scale-up equivalents/loadings are retained without calculating unprinted scaled charges/volume.

unresolved: Scheme 1 omits atmosphere, workup, purification, isolated masses, and row-specific absolute charges beyond the limiting alkyl bromide.
The exact structures of compact scope substrates/products remain source-labeled and unverified where complete stereochemical encoding was uncertain.

regions.region: page 6 Scheme 2 reaction header/caption
regions.finding: Visually verified the shared alkyl-bromide-scope quantities, catalyst/ligand/Zn loadings, DMAc/toluene 3:17 at 0.05 M, −10 °C, 24 h, isolated-yield basis, chiral-HPLC ee basis, and room-temperature footnote for 48.

regions.region: page 6 Scheme 2 products 36–48 and X-ray inset
regions.finding: Recorded all thirteen distinct arrows, yields and ee values; preserved 46's two unassigned diastereomer ee values and 1.1:1 dr, and separated (S)-45's 60%/88% coupling outcome from >99% ee after recrystallization. CCDC 2401168 is characterization provenance, not SI association.

regions.region: page 6 lower-left stereochemical-control discussion
regions.finding: Recorded the preformed Ni-A model reaction (68%, 90% ee), the qualitative nonlinear L7-ee series, and the catalytic-TEMPO/no-ee-effect series. Numerical SI-only points/loadings were left missing.

regions.region: page 6 lower-right proposed catalytic-cycle prose
regions.finding: Classified Ni/radical intermediates I–XI and the reductive-elimination stereodetermining proposal as one mechanism record. The page-7 cycle graphic was used only as cross-page context and page 7 is not claimed as covered.

unresolved: Scheme 2 omits atmosphere, workup, purification, product masses, and row-specific absolute charges beyond the limiting alkyl bromide.
Nonlinear/TEMPO series details are referred to unassociated SI and remain missing.
Proposed cycle intermediates are not independently observed or quantified.
